title: Four builds in one: fixes, Padiano, the dock, effects, XY, the desk
thisBuild: Your notes: pads redraw straight away (#6), Hold keeps short sounds going until you let go (#4), Hold has a Last setting (#1), pages fade instead of snapping (#5), menus show up in more places (#2), and Steps can give each step a pitch (#3).
Pad menus open when you hold still and lift. A slide or a circle never opens one, and a pad you play never scrolls the page.
Padiano (the piano under a row): one row of small squares by default. ⚙ sets how many notes, the size, Squares or Keys, and In key only. Glide and XY sit on its header.
Side dock on the left: Lock (hold it a second to unlock), Hold, a filter and resonance pair for the mix or one pad, and ⋯ to add Rec, Stutter, Echo, XY presets or desk layouts.
Effects: slide along one while you hold it to set how much; ✎ makes it stay on or act as a slider, and aims it at the mix, a bus, or one pad. Hold a pad, then Route, to put it on a bus.
Doctor's table: Reverb, Echo, Dirty, Crush, Chorus and Wobble on any sound.

XY: hold a pad, then XY setup. Two-way or four-way, pick what each direction moves, or use Sweep, Dub, Bend, Lo-fi or Scrub. Draw a circle on a pad or a Padiano note to play it as a sphere. With Rec on while the loop plays, your XY moves record into the loop.

DESK tab, M(ess)(y) Desk: Arrange, then drag pieces anywhere, resize from the pink corner, pin them. Perform, Beats and Sampling layouts, plus your own. ☰ menu, Playing: empty pads record, beat glow, in key only.
watch: Lock the screen mid-jam and try to knock it off the page.
Give a pad the Bend preset, circle one of its Padiano notes and swing it around.
Arrange a desk the way you want it, then play only from that page.
limits: Desk pieces cut off what doesn't fit; make a piece bigger to see more.
Reverb and echo are shared: the sound you played last sets their size and time.
The site plays these sounds without the new effects, XY or glide.
